opportunity.stance: Flow is concentrating in confirmed-trend cyclicals (Real Estate, Health Care, Industrials) with high relative strength and broad breadth, while tech cools. Elevated but dormant VIX and no relief snap suggest a fragile rotation, not a durable risk-on shift; leans are trend-following not predictive.

Without a validated forward edge, these are likely mean-reverting traps to be faded.

All sector leans are therefore 'none' from this lens. VIX avoid is anchored only on the recent miss and the lack of a snap trigger.
